faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Project Scientist at IIT Mandi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Senior Project Scientist post in the IIT Mandi Recruitment 2026. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Mandi Senior Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Senior Project Scientist position at IIT Mandi is 28 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Senior Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in a relevant subject such as disaster risk reduction, natural hazards, and/or infrastructure to be eligible for the Senior Project Scientist position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Senior Project Scientist position at IIT Mandi?
faq.answer: The selected Senior Project Scientist will receive a salary of Rs. 70,000 per month, along with HRA as applicable. This is a well-compensated contractual position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the IIT Mandi Senior Project Scientist recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Senior Project Scientist recruitment at IIT Mandi. This makes it accessible for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Senior Project Scientist posts at IIT Mandi is online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the direct link to apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Project Scientist position at IIT Mandi primarily involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Senior Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Senior Project Scientist position is Mandi, Himachal Pradesh, specifically at the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi campus. It is a government job in the state.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this at IIT Mandi?
faq.answer: This is a contractual government job at the Indian Institute of Technology Mandi. It offers a structured work environment within a prestigious educational institution.

faq.question: Q10. When was the official notification released for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification for the IIT Mandi Senior Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 was released on 03 August 2026. Interested candidates should review the notification for full details.
